footer.tagline: Studying in Czechia end to end: courses, admission, full support.

programs.title: Programmes
programs.lead: End-to-end programmes matched to your goals and budget. Prices are fixed in the contract — no hidden extras.
programs.ctaText: We will match a programme to your goals and budget — free, in a single call.

universities.title: Universities
universities.lead: Public universities in Czechia our students go to. Studying in Czech is free of charge.
universities.ctaText: We prepare you for the entrance exams and handle the paperwork — from courses to enrolment.

living.title: Accommodation
living.lead: Student dormitories next to the universities. We book your place in advance, before you arrive. Payment in instalments is available.

services.title: Additional services
services.lead: Standalone services for those who do not need the full support programme.

blog.title: Our blog about Czechia
blog.lead: Useful articles about studying, paperwork and student life in Czechia.
blog.ctaText: One-year courses at public universities — B2 by the time you apply.

agents.title: Representatives
agents.lead: Our representatives in your country will answer your questions and help with documents and the contract — locally, without travelling to Czechia.

faq.title: Questions and answers
faq.lead: Answers to the questions we are asked most often.
faq.leadAction: Did not find yours — request a call.

partners.title: Partners
partners.lead: Companies and organisations we work with.
partners.partnerCtaText: Write to us or request a call — we will discuss the details.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.lead: Write or call us — we reply during working hours. Our office is in central Brno.
